title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Lender Services Desk Card: Residential Placement Schedule and Certificate Issue
content:
## Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — residential placement schedule

**Where the schedule applies.** For a new placement on the loan named on the most recently mailed first notice of a program on the Residential Mandatory Amount tier, and only for such a placement, the annual premium is set by this residential placement schedule in place of the base premium formula; every renewal on that tier is priced by the residential renewal schedule and a placement on the loan named on the most recently mailed first notice of a program on the Commercial Building tier by the commercial placement schedule, and every other certificate premium remains the building limit divided by 100 times the tier's building rate per 100 plus the contents limit divided by 100 times the tier's contents rate per 100, rounded to the cent, and never less than the tier's minimum certificate premium.

**Mandatory purchase amount.** For a placement this residential placement schedule prices, and only for such a placement, the mandatory purchase amount is the required amount stated on the loan's latest first notice, the figure Tidemark set there as the lowest of the principal balance the lender reported, the tier's NFIP maximum building reference and the insurable value; a placement under the commercial placement schedule follows that schedule's own first-notice rule, a renewal under the residential renewal schedule follows that schedule's renewal-notice rule, and for every other certificate the mandatory purchase amount remains the lowest of those three figures.

**Borrower evidence.** For a placement this residential placement schedule prices, and only for such a placement, acceptable borrower evidence bars the certificate only when it was received on or after the loan's latest first notice, evidence from an earlier lapse not counting; a placement under the commercial placement schedule follows that schedule's own reading, and for every other placement no certificate is issued when acceptable borrower evidence was received before placement.

**Effect of a placement.** The placement issues a new certificate on the loan, recorded as an issue entry under the program, and bills its annual premium to the program account as a new-placement charge on the statement for the current month.

## Invocation — `issue_residential_certificate_c6c06832`

**Capability.** Places lender-placed flood building coverage on one residential loan under the lender's master program: issues a new certificate with a newly assigned certificate number, records the borrower, the building, its flood zone, the balances the lender reports, the mandatory purchase amount, the building limit, the lapse date, the coverage dates and the annual premium, bills that premium to the program account as a new placement and raises the amount the lender owes on the program by the premium.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `issue_residential_certificate_c6c06832` and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `forceplaced_program_id` | Reference number of the lender's master program that places the coverage, as returned by the master program lookup | Identifier |
| `loan_number` | The lender's loan number exactly as shown on the borrower notices in the tracking lookup | Verbatim text |
| `borrower_name` | The borrower's full name exactly as the lender states it on the call | Verbatim text |
| `property_address` | Street address of the mortgaged building exactly as the lender states it | Verbatim text |
| `flood_zone` | Flood zone on the lender's Standard Flood Hazard Determination Form for the building | One of: `A`, `AE`, `AH`, `AO`, `AR`, `A99`, `V`, `VE`, `B`, `C`, `X`, `D`, `NONE` |
| `outstanding_principal_balance` | Unpaid principal balance of the loan as the lender reports it | USD with 2 decimals |
| `insurable_value` | Building's replacement cost value as the lender reports it | USD, whole dollars |
| `required_amount` | Mandatory purchase amount for the loan | USD, whole dollars |
| `building_limit` | Certificate building limit | USD, whole dollars |
| `lapse_date` | Date the borrower's own coverage lapsed or became insufficient | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `coverage_effective_date` | Start date of certificate coverage | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `certificate_expiration_date` | Last day of the certificate term | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `annual_premium` | Annual premium of the certificate | Positive USD amount with 2 decimals; rounded half to even to the cent on booking |

Flood zones: A (special flood hazard area, no base flood elevation); AE (with base flood elevations); AH (shallow ponding); AO (shallow sheet flow); AR (during flood-control system restoration); A99 (protected by a flood-control system under construction); V (coastal high hazard area, no base flood elevation); VE (coastal high hazard area with base flood elevations); B and C (moderate and minimal flood hazard areas on older maps); X (moderate or minimal flood hazard area); D (undetermined); NONE (no zone shown on the form).

**Return.** A confirmation giving the newly assigned certificate number (letters followed by digits), the issue entry reference, the loan number, the coverage dates, the building limit in whole dollars, the premium billed with its statement month (YYYY-MM), the charge entry reference, and the program's amount owed net of the charge. A certificate number in the reply indicates the certificate was issued and billed.
